# Vendored libraries

- cpp-httplib **v0.61.0**: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/tree/v0.61.0 (MIT, `httplib.LICENSE`). Provides the C++ HTTP server and static asset serving.
- nlohmann/json **v3.12.0**: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0 (MIT, `json.LICENSE`). Provides JSON parsing and serialization.

Headers and licenses are copied from the upstream tagged releases. MySQL's client library and OpenSSL are linked from the installed system packages; their implementations are not copied here.
